vault.title: Create your vault password
vault.why: Your provider keys are encrypted with it and never leave your control.
vault.openWhat: Open the vault form to choose a password for your vault.
vault.passwordWhat: Type a password here, then confirm with the button below.

unlock.title: Unlock your vault
unlock.why: Your provider keys stay encrypted until you unlock the vault.
unlock.openWhat: Open the vault form to enter your vault password.
unlock.passwordWhat: Type your vault password here, then confirm with the button below.

cloudVault.title: Create your vault and add one free key
cloudVault.what: Choose a vault password, then add one free key. Google is recommended. You come back here when it is done.
cloudVault.why: Your provider keys are encrypted with your password and never leave your control. A key is how the AI provider knows it's you.

cloudUnlock.what: Unlock your vault on the vault page. You come back here when it is done.

cloudKey.what: Add one free key on the vault page. Google is recommended. You come back here when it is done.

key.title: Add one free key
key.why: NARN Freeway uses free AI models, and the key is how the provider knows it's you.
key.choiceWhat: Create a free Google AI key, then paste it into your vault.
key.pasteWhat: Paste the key here, type your vault password below, then save.

project.title: Bring in your game's text
project.why: NARN reads every entry and only translates what's missing.
project.createWhat: Give your project a name, then create it.
project.sourceWhat: Pick the language your text is written in.
project.targetsWhat: Tick the languages you want to translate into.
project.importWhat: Choose the CSV file you exported from your game editor.
project.confirmWhat: Check the summary, then confirm the import.

translate.title: Translate
translate.why: Freeway picks a suitable free model for each language automatically.
translate.openWhat: Open the tab that lists your entries.
translate.progressWhat: The translation is running. This line shows its progress.
translate.progressWhy: The tour continues when the translation has finished.

failed.title: The translation didn't go through
failed.why: The highlighted bar below shows what happened.
failed.authWhat: The provider rejected your key. Check the key, then try again.
failed.quotaWhat: The free quota is used up for now. Wait a little or add another key, then try again.
failed.otherWhat: Nothing was translated. Check your key, then try again.

parked.title: The translation is paused
parked.what: Your translation is paused and waiting on the provider. Check your key, then stop this run and start a new one.

waiting.title: The translation is waiting
waiting.why: The highlighted bar below shows its status. The tour continues when the translation has finished.
waiting.quotaWhat: The free quota is used up for now. The translation resumes by itself when quota is free again.
waiting.modelWhat: The free models available right now are below the quality this run aims for. The translation resumes by itself when a better one is available.

export.title: Export
export.why: Your game editor can import this file to bring the translations into your game.
export.openWhat: Go back to the tab where you imported your file.
export.downloadWhat: Download the translated file for your game editor.

closing.title: You're all set
closing.what: Advanced adds glossaries, quality checks, routing, reviews and more.
closing.why: You can switch at any time from the top bar.

providerChoice.title: Use my own provider
providerChoice.description: Pick the provider you have a key for. NARN will send every translation in your projects to it. To combine several providers, switch to Advanced.
providerChoice.existingRouting: This project already has routing set up, so it stays as it is. You can change it in Advanced.

confirm.title: Switch to Simple for the guided setup?
confirm.body: The guided setup is built for Simple mode, which hides the advanced tabs. You can switch back at any time from the top bar.

offer.title: New to Routing?
offer.body: A 30-second look at how NARN picks who translates what.

config.title: Routing picks who translates
config.what: This is where you choose which translation provider handles your strings.
config.why: Use it to send some languages or kinds of text to a different provider, or to keep one provider for everything.

mode.title: Simple or advanced rules
mode.what: Switch here between one provider for everything and a list of rules.
mode.why: Start simple. Move to rules when you want a different provider for a language, a category or a tone.

offer.title: New to Glossaries?
offer.body: A short look at keeping names and key terms consistent.

list.title: Your glossaries
list.what: Each glossary is a list of terms with the translation you want for each.
list.why: Terms such as character names or game jargon then come out the same way every time.

create.title: Start a glossary
create.what: Create an empty glossary and add your own terms to it.
create.why: Do this when you already know the words that must never be translated differently.

generate.title: Let AI suggest terms
generate.what: Ask an AI provider to find likely terms in your strings.
generate.why: It saves you reading the whole file to find them. You review and accept what it proposes.

offer.title: New to Quality?
offer.body: A short look at how NARN checks your translations.

title.title: Automatic quality checks
title.what: Every translation is checked against rules such as missing tags, changed placeholders and length limits.
title.why: Problems that would break your game show up here instead of in play-testing.

overview.title: Your pass rate
overview.what: This shows how many checks passed and how many failed across the project.
overview.why: A quick way to tell whether the translations are ready or still need work.

issues.title: The most common problems
issues.what: The kinds of problem that fail most often are listed here.
issues.why: Fixing the most common one first clears the most failures.

offer.title: New to Compare?
offer.body: A short look at reviewing translations side by side.

target.title: Pick the language
target.what: Choose which language to look at next to the source text.
target.why: Review one language at a time, line by line, and edit as you go.

reference.title: Add a reference language
reference.what: Show a second language alongside, such as one you read well.
reference.why: Useful when you cannot read the target language: you can check the meaning against a language you know.

translate.title: Translate from here
translate.what: Translate the rows you selected, or all rows that match your filters.
translate.why: Handy for filling gaps you spot while reviewing, without leaving this tab.

offer.title: New to AI review?
offer.body: A short look at having an AI check your translations.

intro.title: A second opinion on translations
intro.what: An AI provider reads your translations next to the source and scores them.
intro.why: It finds mistakes and awkward wording that automatic checks cannot, so you can fix them before shipping.

start.title: Review the last run
start.what: Start a review of the most recent translation run.
start.why: Reviewing just what was translated lately keeps the cost and the wait small.

all.title: Review everything
all.what: Review all translations in the project, not only the latest run.
all.why: Use it before a release, or after you changed the glossary or routing.
